tool_purposes.pubchem: Resolve source-supported molecular substance identities; verify exact names, synonyms, formulae, structures, and PubChem identifiers without changing hydrate, charge, stoichiometry, counterion, or stereochemistry.
tool_purposes.ccdc: Resolve source-supported crystallographic identities and explicit CCDC identifiers; never infer a crystal identity from a similar name or structure.
tool_purposes.enhanced_websearch: Perform targeted evidence lookup for a source-supported identity when primary specialist services are insufficient; external pages may enrich identity fields but must never prove participation in the source procedure.
